title: Normalized homology comparisons are natural
statement: Let $C$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], $\mathcal F$ the full category of finite decreasing filtered cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration], and $D(U,r)$ representative page differential data for every $U\in\mathcal F,r\ge1$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. Let $m(t,r)$ be any family of page chain maps satisfying the universal four-square property [lem-sp-filtered-quotient-page-maps]. For each $U,r,a$ let $e(U,r,a):H(D(U,r).\mathrm{page})^a\cong Q_{r+1}^a(U)$ satisfy the successor-representative normalization [lem-sp-filtered-complex-normalized-homology]. Then for each filtered map $t:U\to V$ one has $H(m(t,r))^a e(V,r,a)=e(U,r,a)m(t,r+1)^a$.

source.place: Tag 012K, Lemmas 12.24.2 and 12.24.4; parent proof step 3, commutation with normalized homology comparisons; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: Take the epic successor-cycle covers on U and V, and obtain a successor-cycle restriction compatible with the current cycle maps and successor page projections.

Precompose with the source successor-cycle cover followed by the homology projection. Homology projection naturality and the first compatibility square, followed by target normalization, rewrite the left side to k followed by the successor projection. Source normalization and the second square give the same right side. Cancel the epic composite.

theorem filteredQuotient_homology_naturality
    (D : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)) (r : ℤ) (_hr : 1 ≤ r),
      FilteredComplexPageDifferential U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration r)
    (m : ∀ {U V : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)}
      (_t : U ⟶ V) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
      (D U r hr).page ⟶ (D V r hr).page)
    (hm : ∀ U V (t : U ⟶ V) r hr,
      FilteredQuotientPageMapProperty (C := C) U V t r (D U r hr) (D V r hr) (m t r hr))
    (e : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
      (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
      (D U r hr).page.homology pq ≅
        filteredComplexPageObject U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration (r + 1) pq)
    (he : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
      (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
      FilteredComplexHomologyNormalized (C := C) U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration r (D U r hr) pq
        (e U r hr pq))
    (U V : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
    (t : U ⟶ V) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (m t r hr) pq ≫ (e V r hr pq).hom =
      (e U r hr pq).hom ≫ (m t (r + 1) (le_trans hr (Int.le_add_one le_rfl))).f pq
